instruction: I owed people some money. They put the associated expenses on Splitwise yesterday. I paid some of them up on Venmo today. Please record payments on Splitwise for each in their respective groups. Each payment should have a note, "Paid via Venmo, see attached receipt.", and an attached Venmo receipt of it as a proof.
notes: Representative instance with two Venmo payments (txn-1, txn-2) to two payees; the real number of payments is discovered at runtime from venmo.show_transactions (sent, today) and one transaction/receipt/group/amount object is instantiated per match. World facts (venmo-paid-today, owed-in-group, receipt-path-for) are static in :init but agent knowledge is gated by the lookup flags transactions-listed (venmo.show_transactions) and expenses-listed (splitwise.show_activity, which exposes yesterday's expenses with their group_id). Receipts are downloaded to the file system with the file_system token and attached via receipt_file_path/file_system_access_token in splitwise.record_payment, whose preconditions enforce payer = supervisor, receiver = payee, amount = Venmo amount, group = group of the matching expense, and the fixed note. supervisor.complete_task takes the two recorded transactions as non-API record parameters with an equality constraint so it is only applicable once both payments are recorded; no answer is passed.
